second_stage.map: true 746825-coordinate invariant Boolean coefficient residual restricted to each 467-dimensional evaluation kernel

proof_logic: Use the certified invertible 6666-square base augmented evaluation minor M. For an added block B, eliminate its base-row values with X=M^{-1}B_base. The 6651 complementary Boolean rows give Schur residual R=B_extra-M_extra X of rank 6184 and kernel dimension 467. Every true coefficient relation must therefore use c=N z from this kernel. Applying the exact direct-covariant coefficient map (14400 times the canonical K-pencil adjoint; the 14400/d single-q Schur factor gains d under the J^{-1} representation-index contraction) to B N-[A_base,target] X N gives a 746825 by 467 residual family H. A nonzero 467-square minor of H makes H injective, so z=0. Thus all 13317 augmented columns are independent modulo 24001. Since all characteristic-zero denominators are invertible modulo 24001, the same columns are independent over Q(sqrt(5),i).
scope: This decides both smallest one-block enlargements of the previously refuted four-block party-symmetric degree-4 Boolean SOS ansatz. It does not decide the six-block ansatz containing both blocks 8 and 17, nor the full 20-block SOS problem.
